purpose: Canonical, CI-enforced inventory of SEIS's own real, existing technology components — not an aspirational catalog of engines or capabilities that don't exist yet. Every entry below is a component with a real path in this repository today.
scope_note: This registry intentionally does not contain entries for game engines, 3D/rendering pipelines, digital-human systems, robotics, aerospace, quantum computing, or any of the other domains sometimes discussed as long-term direction for SEIS. Those are not implemented in this repository and are not represented here. Adding an entry to this registry is a claim that the thing exists and works as described — see docs/decisions/technology-registry-adoption.md.

entries.name: SEIS Desktop Shell (Tauri)
entries.permissions: Local filesystem read of the staged cockpit bundle; no network access, no destructive actions exposed.
entries.hardware_requirements: None beyond a GPU capable of WebKitGTK (Linux) or WebView2 (Windows) rendering.
entries.tests: No automated test suite; verified by a manual, screenshot-evidenced build-and-run pass under Xvfb on Ubuntu 24.04, documented in apps/desktop/native/README.md.
entries.fallback: If the native shell cannot build, the same views remain available via apps/web/cockpit.html in any browser.
entries.rollback: Revert the commits under apps/desktop/native/; nothing here is depended on by any other shipped surface.
entries.status: Linux is reference_implementation (screenshot-verified). Windows is shell_scaffolded_build_pending (source exists, entirely unverified — no Windows toolchain available in this environment). See apps/desktop/shell-contract.json for the authoritative per-platform status.

entries.name: SEIS macOS Inspector (SwiftUI)
entries.permissions: None — read-only nav list and a static placeholder detail pane, no data binding, no filesystem or network access.
entries.fallback: None — this is itself the reference UI for the shared desktop shell contract.
entries.rollback: Revert apps/macos/; the shared shell-contract.json is unaffected.
entries.status: reference_implementation per apps/macos/inspector-contract.json — a nav list and a static placeholder pane, no real data binding. Not a claim of a shipped, data-bound app.

entries.name: SEIS Web Cockpit
entries.permissions: None — static HTML/CSS/JS with embedded data, no runtime network calls from cockpit.html itself.
entries.tests: No dedicated automated test for cockpit.html; its data is generated by scripts/create-cockpit-status.mjs, which is covered by npm run check:cockpit-status.
entries.fallback: None — this is the reference surface the desktop shells wrap rather than reimplement.
entries.rollback: Revert the relevant commit; apps/web/index.html (the separate marketing page) is unaffected.
entries.status: In active use as the data source both desktop shells wrap; six panels (repository, plugins, build, workspace, security, research) render real embedded data generated from data/ and docs/research/ sources.

entries.name: SEIS Icon Governance System
entries.tests: Is itself a CI-run validator (npm run check:icon-system), wired into npm run check:governance and .github workflows.
entries.fallback: None needed — a failing check blocks merge rather than shipping a drifted icon.
entries.rollback: Revert the manifest/script changes; existing icon files are unaffected.
entries.status: Stable and enforced: validates viewBox drift, non-canonical colors, missing accessible names, and text-as-icon regressions across 9 registered icons as of 2026-08-25.

entries.name: App Shell Contract Validator
entries.tests: Is itself a CI-run validator (npm run check:app-shell-contracts), wired into npm run check:governance.
entries.status: Stable and enforced across three contracts (Android, macOS, desktop) as of 2026-08-25: validates required fields, entity references, icon visual-only rule, scaffold paths, and per-platform status presence.

entries.name: SEIS Plugin Capability Catalog
entries.permissions: Governs, but does not itself perform, external plugin/connector activation.
entries.tests: Is itself validated by npm run check:aggressive-capability-map.
entries.status: Stable and CI-enforced; groups the real external plugin/MCP ecosystem into governed capability families with explicit activation gates.

entries.name: SEIS Backend State Model
entries.permissions: None — a data contract document, not a running service.
entries.fallback: The static consumer (apps/web/src/data/cockpit-status.js) keeps working even though the live Convex-backed consumer described in consumer_contract does not exist yet.
entries.rollback: Revert entity additions; existing consumers are additive-only and unaffected.
entries.status: model_committed_backend_not_provisioned — the entity shapes are real and consumed by the static cockpit bundle; no live Convex/Postgres backend has been provisioned.
